entry.original:
In the depths of the pit gate, you have discovered a massive cavern system infested with fleshbeasts.

The cavern system is clogged with masses of living flesh that block your progress. Attack the fleshmass to destroy it.

The entire cavern system seems unstable. If you find what lies behind the fleshmass, you may be able to collapse the tunnels and close the pit gate.

UnusedTranslations.entry:
En las profundidades de la puerta del pozo, has descubierto un sistema masivo de cavernas infestado de bestias de carne.

El sistema de cavernas está obstruido con masas de carne viva que bloquean tu progreso. Ataca la masa de carne para destruirla.

Todo el sistema de cavernas parece inestable. Si encuentras lo que hay detrás de la masa de carne, es posible que puedas colapsar los túneles y cerrar la puerta del pozo.
Acerca de: Vinculación con árbol de ánima antiguo

The ancient anima tree now has {0} anima grass around it. This is enough for a tribal person to begin their first linking ritual!

The linking ritual gives a level of psylink and the ability to use psychic powers. Upgrading to a higher level requires 20 grass.
